subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram pinned-message reads be exposed only as an on-demand gated message action, or should OpenClaw also inject pinned content automatically at session start?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how persistent Telegram room context is authorized, gated, surfaced to agents, and documented.

options.title: On-demand gated read
options.body: Expose a Telegram pinned-read/list-pins action through the plugin with a dedicated gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

options.title: Automatic pinned context
options.body: Add session-start pinned-message injection only after defining opt-in configuration, privacy, prompt-injection, and refresh semantics.

options.title: Defer to broader reads
options.body: Keep this blocked until the broader Telegram message-read and retained-context contract is settled.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read
recommendation.body: Expose a Telegram pinned-read/list-pins action through the plugin with a dedicated gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available owner for the product/security choice because their recent plugin-boundary work and the issue timeline mention connect them to this decision surface.
